body: 5d18434387 (PR2b). Fixes: (1) launch token gates binding, so unrelated sessions allocate -02; (2) inherited session env is scrubbed in all launch envs, and the session id/CLAUDE_PID are read for the running vendor only (aligned with PR3's agy AIDA_AGENT_TYPE export; no overlapping files, so no cherry-pick); (3) released/expired reservations mint a new UUID with previous_recipients; (4) LaunchReservationGuard and register compare-release on failure; (5) tmux --tmux-pane-pid #{pane_pid} pane resolution, and agy statusline resolves by ancestry (conversationId is verified for hooks per agy 1.4.2 hooks.md, the statusline payload is undocumented upstream); (6) PidObserver::current(); (7) /clear doc; F2 adopt never writes a refused name; F5 ls '-'; F6 one validator. Gates: targeted cargo (488 ok), make check-ci-fast ok. Each fix has a test.
